name: pr-workflow
description: Rules for agents working on issues and pull requests: habits for any PR the session opens, the author role and the maintainer-side intake in configured repos, and a hook that names the rules before the first gh call to a configured repo.

author_repos.title: Author repos
author_repos.description: Comma-separated owner/repo list where the author rules apply (start from an agreed issue, open only when done, hand each head back on the PR, update from the default branch without asking; never review requests, approvals, gate or merge).

intake_repos.title: Intake repos
intake_repos.description: Comma-separated owner/repo list where you are the maintainer and the intake rules apply to PRs the session didn't open.

gate_status.title: Gate status
gate_status.description: Name of the commit status the intake sets on a head the issue's agreement covers (empty: no gate status).

standing_merge.title: Standing merge
standing_merge.description: Whether the intake merges a ready PR without asking: the owner's standing authorisation. Release PRs always need the owner's explicit "merge it".

bot_logins.title: Bot logins
bot_logins.description: Comma-separated bot PR authors in API form (e.g. dependabot[bot]) whose PRs may get a clean update from the default branch from the maintainer side.
